# VT Analyzer

> VT Analyzer is a free YouTube thumbnail analyzer and checker. Upload or paste a thumbnail image and it scores readability, contrast, focal point, color saturation, and aspect ratio/resolution against YouTube's display specs, then shows separate mobile and web previews with specific, actionable suggestions to improve click-through rate.

All analysis runs client-side in the browser (HTML5 Canvas API) — no image is uploaded to a server, no signup is required, and the tool is free to use.

## Core Tool
- [Thumbnail Analyzer](https://vtanalyzer.site/): Upload a YouTube thumbnail to get an instant score, mobile vs. web preview, and improvement suggestions.
- [How It Works](https://vtanalyzer.site/how-it-works/): The exact five-step scoring process and the weighting of each factor (readability, contrast, focal point, saturation, brightness, aspect ratio, resolution, file size).

## Reference
- [FAQ](https://vtanalyzer.site/faq/): Answers on YouTube thumbnail size, dimensions, aspect ratio, resolution, file formats, thumbnail makers (Canva, ChatGPT), and YouTube's thumbnail rules.
- [About](https://vtanalyzer.site/about/): Who built VT Analyzer, the scoring approach, and who the tool is for.

## Policies
